Chapter 221: Chapter 15: Breaking Through Sixth Rank (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

Chapter 221: Chapter 15: Breaking Through Sixth Rank (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

Several robust men beside him were drenched in sweat as they massaged him.

“Put a bit more strength into it, you guys. Didn’t you eat last night?”

“Even harder, I’m telling you, as long as it feels good, money is no issue…”

This member of the Demonic Mouse Race was enjoying himself.

Suddenly.

The Demonic Mouse Race powerhouse shuddered abruptly.

...

“Hm?”

The strong member of the Demonic Mouse Race looked towards the direction of Central Mainland, his small eyes suddenly widening.

“Is this a breakthrough to the Sixth Rank?”

The strong member of the Demonic Mouse Race was dumbfounded.

He remembered that Lin Yuan, whom he protected under the command of the Goddess of Wisdom, had only the strength of the Fourth Rank.

How did he suddenly reach the Sixth Rank?

“How long has it been?”

The powerful member of the Demonic Mouse Race almost thought time was in disorder, but after some thinking, he confirmed he had only been on Canglan Star for not even a year.

“What a monstrosity…”

The strong member of the Demonic Mouse Race blinked.

Even though he knew that Lin Yuan, who had the Goddess of Wisdom intervene to bring him to this planet as a bodyguard, was no ordinary individual,

such a leap across two major realms in such a short time was too frightening.

…

Central Continent Manor.

Main building’s underground training area.

“So this is the Sixth Rank…”

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes.

At this moment, he felt everything had changed. The myriad cosmic energies diffusing between heaven and earth were distinctly visible to him, especially the powers of Taiyin and Taiyang, which he could now discern as effortlessly as if viewing the patterns on one’s palm.

“I finally succeeded…”

A smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face.

In the Main World, whether it was human civilization or other different species civilizations, the Sixth Rank was a boundary. It marked the divide between planetary life and cosmic life.

Before reaching the Sixth Rank, life was extremely fragile; one could barely survive off their planet without the aid of tools.

But at the Sixth Rank, the cosmic starry sky instead felt more like home.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure vanished.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan appeared outside Canglan Star.

Under the deep and vast cosmic starry skies.

Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

The originally chaotic and violent cosmic energies, now tame like a kitten, were all drawn into his body.

“Canglan Star…”

Lin Yuan turned his head to look towards the distant Canglan Star.

At this moment, the enormous Canglan Star appeared somewhat blustery, its internal strength not as robust as its exterior suggested. Though it boasted a planetary defense system, Lin Yuan could breach the planet in a short time if he so desired.

The lives of Canglan Star’s fifty billion citizens hung on Lin Yuan’s single thought.

The planetary defense system could only delay Lin Yuan for a while but was very unlikely to stop him.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan seemed to have noticed something and looked toward the left front.

There appeared a bald man, “Little Junior Brother.”

“Big Senior Brother?”

Lin Yuan immediately recognized the bald man, who was indeed his Big Senior Brother.

Their auras were almost identical.

“And also…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking towards another location.

There appeared a dwarf man, measuring only one meter fifty.

“Don’t get excited yet.”

The dwarf man immediately spoke, “It’s the Goddess of Wisdom who sent me here.”

“Goddess of Wisdom.”

Lin Yuan connected with the Goddess of Wisdom and after confirming, nodded slightly.

“Is it really the Goddess of Wisdom?”

The bald man was somewhat astonished; just earlier while he was protecting Lin Yuan, he had sensed the dwarf man’s presence.

The two nearly came to blows until the dwarf man confirmed that the bald man was not an enemy and voluntarily stated that he was commissioned by the Goddess of Wisdom to protect ‘Lin Yuan’.

Upon hearing this, although the bald man was skeptical, he halted his intent to strike since he did not detect any malicious intent from the dwarf man.

And during the time he had been protecting Lin Yuan, the dwarf man had not made a move,

If the latter truly harbored a killing intent, he would not wait until after Lin Yuan’s breakthrough to the Sixth Rank to show himself.

“Is Mr. Lin… the Peak Master of the Thirteen Peaks of the Red Kun Lineage?”

The dwarf man carefully observed Lin Yuan and spoke softly.

It wasn’t difficult to guess. The imminent breakthrough to the Sixth Rank by the Peak Master of the Thirteen Peaks of the Red Kun Lineage was well-known, and at this time, coinciding with Lin Yuan’s breakthrough, it was easy to put two and two together.

Moreover, Lin Yuan had a Seventh Rank powerhouse protecting him.

Only someone with such a background could belong to the Red Kun Lineage.

“Thank you, Mister of the Demon Mouse Race, for your protection during this time…”

Lin Yuan, having learned the approximate details from the Goddess of Wisdom, immediately expressed his gratitude.

“There’s no need for thanks; I was merely following orders.”

The dwarf man shook his head, “I was curious about the identity of the Thirteen Peaks Master of Chikun, but I never expected it to be the ‘Mr. Lin’ I was protecting…”

The dwarf man looked astonished.

He had a premonition that, soon, the whole Chikun Star Domain, and even the surrounding star domains, would be continually shaken by the true identity of the Thirteen Peaks Master.
